note: Independent labelled set for offline evaluation. Written from the app's own UI labels and drawer contents, not from guide_features.json. Scope is limited to features reachable on NewPipe 0.27.0: its YouTube extractor fails on the Trending kiosk and on stream resolution ('Could not parse website'), so video-playback and Trending features are deliberately excluded.

features.name: View the newest uploads feed
features.description: Land on the main page and read the What's New feed of recent uploads.
actions: Launch the app and land on the main page
Wait for the feed of recent uploads to render
Scroll the feed to reveal further items

features.name: Look up content by keyword
features.description: Use the search bar to find videos matching a typed query.
actions: Tap the search icon in the toolbar
Type a search term into the input field
Submit the query with the keyboard action
Wait for the result list to appear

features.name: Narrow results by content type
features.description: Restrict search output to videos, channels or playlists using the result filter.
actions: Perform a search so results are shown
Open the filter control on the results screen
Choose a content type such as videos, channels or playlists
Confirm the filter and observe the narrowed list

features.name: Re-run a previous search
features.description: Reuse a stored search suggestion from search history.
actions: Observe the previous queries listed as suggestions
Tap one of the stored queries
Wait for its results to load

features.name: Review saved downloads
features.description: Open the downloads screen and inspect stored or in-progress items.
actions: Open the menu on a download entry

features.name: Review followed channels
features.description: Open the subscriptions feed listing followed channels.
actions: Wait for the subscription feed to load

features.name: Open saved playlists
features.description: Browse the bookmarked playlists stored on the device.
actions: Open one playlist to see its items

features.name: Review what was watched
features.description: Open watch history and inspect or clear previously played items.
actions: Open the history menu to clear or delete an entry

features.name: Adjust the app's look
features.description: Change the theme or appearance preferences.
actions: Return and observe the applied theme

features.name: Tune playback quality
features.description: Change a video or audio preference in settings.
actions: Open the Video and audio section
Change a resolution or audio format preference

features.name: Configure download behaviour
features.description: Change where or how downloaded files are stored.
actions: Change a download path or naming preference

features.name: Read the app information
features.description: Open the About screen with version and licence details.
actions: Read the version and project information
Switch between the About and Licences tabs

features.name: Adjust content preferences
features.description: Change a content preference such as the default kiosk or content language.
actions: Change the default kiosk or content language

features.name: Manage stored history data
features.description: Open history and cache settings and clear stored data.
actions: Open the History and cache section
Choose an option to clear cached or stored data

features.name: Control notification behaviour
features.description: Review and change the app's notification preferences.

features.name: Export or import app data
features.description: Open backup and restore options for the local database.
actions: Open the Backup and restore section
Review the export and import options

features.name: Reset a typed query
features.description: Clear the text currently entered in the search field.
actions: Tap the clear control in the field
